en:
## New Features

- Terminal node context menu: rename, minimize, and close terminals directly from the graph
- Display reasoning/thinking blocks in SubagentCard for subagent transparency

## Improvements

- Regenerate action replaced with rollback-to-block: semantically clearer "rollback to block" instead of "regenerate from message", with new API path and UI icon
- Enhanced summary model error handling: distinguish between provider unavailable and API call failure, show detailed error info in modal
- General subagent permissions tightened from blacklist to whitelist (read-only tools + AskUserQuestion + Skill)
- Rollback preview API optimized: removed unused content fields, avoiding expensive double file-state rebuilds
- RollbackConfirmModal uses TruncatedPath component for consistent path display
- Director layout refinements: unified border styles, slimmer resize handles, cleaner visual hierarchy

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed subagent suspended Promise lacking timeout protection, preventing permanent memory leaks when users abandon suspended subagents
- Fixed toolUseId collision causing cross-fork data pollution when updating subagent conclusions after copy-on-write
- Fixed Ruler timeline commit message layout when edge="end" in vertical mode
- External provider balance endpoint returns 422 instead of 401 to avoid triggering frontend auth logout
- Fixed TerminalGrid React key tracking by using terminalId

## Testing

- New narrator-rollback.test.ts with 17 tests covering rollback and preview scenarios
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 终端节点右键菜单：支持在故事网络图中直接重命名、最小化和关闭终端
- SubagentCard 展示子代理的推理/思考块，提升子代理透明度

## 改进

- 重新生成操作重构为回退到块：语义从「重新生成」改为「回退到指定 block」，更新 API 路径和 UI 图标
- 增强摘要模型错误处理：区分 provider 不可用和 API 调用失败两种情况，弹窗展示详细错误信息
- General 子代理权限从黑名单切换为白名单模式（只读工具 + AskUserQuestion + Skill）
- 回退预览 API 优化：移除未使用的内容字段，避免两次重量级文件状态重建
- 回退确认弹窗使用 TruncatedPath 组件统一路径展示
- Director 布局优化：统一边框样式、更细的拖拽手柄、更简洁的视觉层次

## 修复

- 修复子代理暂停 Promise 缺少超时保护，防止用户放弃暂停的子代理时造成永久内存泄漏
- 修复 copy-on-write 后 toolUseId 冲突导致跨 fork 数据污染
- 修复 Ruler 时间轴垂直模式下 edge="end" 时提交信息布局错误
- 外部提供商余额接口返回 422 替代 401，避免误触发前端全局认证清除
- 修复 TerminalGrid 使用 terminalId 作为 React key 提升追踪准确性

## 测试

- 新增 narrator-rollback.test.ts，包含 17 个测试覆盖回退和预览场景
